Package common.core.subsystems

Class RollerMechanism

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
common.core.subsystems.MechanismBase
common.core.subsystems.RollerMechanism
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem
public class RollerMechanism extends MechanismBase
Something that spins: intakes, hoppers, kickers, shooter flywheels.

Every roller can run open loop with MechanismBase.run(double) or MechanismBase.runVolts(double). Rollers built with a RollerMechanism.VelocityControl can also hold a velocity with MechanismBase.setSetpoint(double), and keep spinning until disabled or run open loop. 


 // An intake roller you just turn on and off
 intakeRoller = new RollerMechanism("IntakeRoller", ROLLER_CONFIG, DCMotor.getKrakenX60(1), 3,
     RollerSimModel.solidCylinderMoi(0.5, 0.025), new NAR_TalonFX(ROLLER_ID));
 intakeRoller.run(0.8);

 // A flywheel that holds a speed, in rotations per second
 flywheel = new RollerMechanism("Flywheel", FLYWHEEL_CONFIG, VelocityControl.PID, FLYWHEEL_GAINS, 1,
     DCMotor.getKrakenX60(1), 1, RollerSimModel.solidCylinderMoi(1.5, 0.05), new NAR_TalonFX(FLYWHEEL_ID));
 flywheel.setSetpoint(60);

    • RollerMechanism

      public RollerMechanism(String name, NAR_Motor.MotorConfig motorConfig, edu.wpi.first.math.system.plant.DCMotor motorType, double gearing, double moiKgMetersSq, NAR_Motor... motors)
      Creates an open-loop roller.
      Parameters:
      name - Name shown on Shuffleboard and in logs
      motorConfig - Applied to every motor
      motorType - Model of one motor, e.g. DCMotor.getKrakenX60(1); used only in simulation
      gearing - Motor rotations per roller rotation; used only in simulation
      moiKgMetersSq - Roller inertia, see RollerSimModel.solidCylinderMoi(double, double) and RollerSimModel.hollowCylinderMoi(double, double, double); used only in simulation
      motors - Every motor on the roller. The first is the leader.

    • RollerMechanism

      public RollerMechanism(String name, NAR_Motor.MotorConfig motorConfig, RollerMechanism.VelocityControl control, PIDFFConfig gains, double tolerance, edu.wpi.first.math.system.plant.DCMotor motorType, double gearing, double moiKgMetersSq, NAR_Motor... motors)
      Creates a velocity-controlled roller.
      Parameters:
      name - Name shown on Shuffleboard and in logs
      motorConfig - Applied to every motor; sets the velocity units
      control - PID or bang-bang
      gains - kS/kV feedforward, and kP/kI/kD for PID, all in volts per velocity unit
      tolerance - How close to the setpoint counts as MechanismBase.atSetpoint(), in velocity units
      motorType - Model of one motor, e.g. DCMotor.getKrakenX60(1); used only in simulation
      gearing - Motor rotations per roller rotation; used only in simulation
      moiKgMetersSq - Roller inertia; used only in simulation
      motors - Every motor on the roller. The first is the leader.

  • Method Details

    • calculateFeedforward

      protected double calculateFeedforward(double pidOutput)
      Description copied from class: MechanismBase
      Feedforward worked out on the roboRIO, in volts. Default is none.

      When the roboRIO runs the loop, override this to add e.g. gains.positionFF(pidOutput, atSetpoint()). When the motor controller runs the loop it already applies kS, kV and kG, so only override this for anything extra it can't do, e.g. a kG that changes with an elevator's height.

      Overrides:
      calculateFeedforward in class MechanismBase
      Parameters:
      pidOutput - The output of feedback this cycle, or the error (setpoint minus measurement) when the motor controller runs the loop. Use it to sign kS.
